recipes.title: Fresh Herb Omelette
steps: Finely chop the chives, parsley and dill.
Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper, then stir in the herbs.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and cook, gently pulling the edges toward the center, until almost set.
Fold the omelette in half and slide it onto a plate.

recipes.title: Zucchini Chicken Omelette
steps: Dice the onion and slice the zucchini into thin half-moons.
Shred the cooked chicken into bite-size pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a pan and cook the onion and zucchini until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and warm it through.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables and cook until set.
Fold, cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Spinach Mushroom Omelette with Parmesan
steps: Slice the mushrooms.
Melt the butter in a pan and cook the mushrooms until golden, about 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until wilted.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and pour them over the vegetables.
Cook until almost set, sprinkle with parmesan, fold and serve.

recipes.title: Spinach Feta Scramble
steps: Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat.
Add the spinach and stir until wilted.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper, pour them in and stir gently until just set.
Crumble the feta over the top and serve.

recipes.title: Baked Spinach Egg Cups
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F and brush a muffin tin with the olive oil.
Chop the spinach and divide it between the cups.
Whisk the eggs with the parmesan, salt and pepper, and pour over the spinach.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the eggs are set.

recipes.title: Chickpea Scallion Fritters
steps: Drain the garbanzo beans and mash them in a bowl.
Slice the scallions and stir them into the mash with the egg.
Heat the oil in a skillet and fry spoonfuls of the mix for 3 minutes per side.
Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.

recipes.title: Spinach Tomato Egg Quesadilla
steps: Dice the onion and tomato, and chop the spinach.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and cook the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add the spinach and tomato, then the whisked eggs with a pinch of salt, and stir until just set.
Spoon the eggs onto one tortilla, top with the cheddar and the second tortilla.
Cook in the pan for 2 minutes per side, until the cheese melts. Cut into wedges.
